steps.detail: PHP lists upstream releases 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. steps.title: PHP susceptibility advisory - published 2026-10-21
steps.detail: PHP documents an unauthenticated pre-application mod_php demonstration and discusses other SAPIs with susceptibility qualifications. Broad web-serving risk attribution is not proof of equal demonstrated exploitability for every SAPI, configuration, version or patched installation.

steps.title: PHP request-state advisory - published 2026-10-21
steps.detail: The request-state advisory separates concrete demonstrations from candidate cases and configuration-dependent, same-worker request-state paths. Compare the cited SAPI and request prerequisites; this hub has not established them for any deployment.

steps.title: CISA conditional guidance - alert revised 2026-10-23
steps.detail: CISA advises temporary offline status when organizations cannot update immediately or continue using unsupported PHP 8.1 or earlier, until patched or updated. This is attributed guidance under those conditions, not a finding that every numerically older build is unpatched or unpatchable. The retained page does not establish its initial publication time.

steps.title: Separate PHP follow-up - notice published 2026-10-23
steps.detail: The initial-pair release list does not establish a fix for the later CVE-2026-115560. PHP described a next-regular-release plan and session.upload_progress.enabled=0 as an interim setting for an unusual path: php_binary or php_serialize switched to php through ini_set() before session_start(), with upload progress still enabled. That conditional measure is not complete mitigation of the initial pair. These sources do not establish a shipped third fix or historical CVE-registry absence.

taxonomy.interpretation: Fifteen distinct CNA-supplied CWE identifiers occur across eleven main CVE contexts. Thirteen retained taxonomy links connect CWE-287 (eight) and CWE-78 (five) to named patterns. These are classification associations, not thirteen attacks or thirteen distinct weaknesses. Three selected CAPEC patterns have captured definition summaries; the other ten are names from CWE tables. This report includes sixteen selective taxonomy contexts; full supplied catalogue counts remain forty-one entities, thirty-five relations and eighty-three evidence occurrences, without implying that all are reproduced here.

limitations: This is a late, partial source-publication and CVE-context report, not an incident count, new-disclosure census or assessment of installed exposure.
The input was generated at 17:41:42 UTC and captured at 18:25:34.817799–18:25:44.220987 UTC. Its 4,698-second generation-to-cutoff gap is unobserved; later capture or compilation does not fill it.

CNA, KEV and catalogue fields are retained source-attributed context with their own update/retrieval clocks, not independent current primary-source revalidation or a historical as-of-cutoff reconstruction.
No selected KEV-addition rows does not mean no KEV additions or exploitation occurred. Six captured KEV-listed contexts are separate from the zero selected additions.
Source history and dates are bounded and selective. The declared 1998–2026 snapshot window, empty cohorts and source failures do not establish complete historical coverage or absence of events.
Date-only values use a UTC-calendar convention with unknown publisher timezone; three boundary rows are excluded from the main cohort.
CNA version strings, default statuses, custom bounds and source truncation are retained without numerical inversion. Fixed boundaries alone do not establish a shipped fix or installed patch state.
Two publication labels and two Moxa CNA text fields remain withheld as NULL. Their records and metric memberships remain present.
Prior citation metadata was reconciled, but no new article bodies, qualified baselines or semantic comparisons were obtained. Unknown and held routes are not unchanged or eligible.
Actor and campaign names are source-attributed background; taxonomy associations do not establish identity, participation, an observed attack or exposure.
No local inventory, device validation, remediation action, new publisher-body research or independent report-URL availability check was performed.
